title: Affine Averaging of Normalized Hermite Polynomials
statement:
For every natural number $k$ and real numbers $\rho,s,x$ satisfying $\rho^2+s^2=1$, the normalized Hermite polynomial $H_k$ obeys
\[
\int_{\mathbb R} H_k(\rho x+sy)\,d\gamma(y)=\rho^k H_k(x),
\]
where $\gamma$ is the standard Gaussian probability measure.
